title: Law to require a plan to inspect and enforce e-bike battery safety
summary: This bill would require the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection and the Fire Department to create, by March 1, 2027, a targeted outreach, inspection and enforcement plan to reduce fires caused by powered bicycles, mobility devices and their storage batteries. The plan would prioritize risky locations and sellers, address online sales of noncompliant devices, and promote safe charging and storage education. Starting April 1, 2027, agencies would also have to report quarterly on related fire incidents, inspections and enforcement actions.
